title: Primavera Sound Buenos Aires and Brazil 2026 to Feature Headliners Gorillaz, Strokes and FKA Twigs
summary: Lily Allen, Yung Lean, CMAT, Courtney Barnett, Cara Delevingne and others are also on both show's lineups.
contentText:
This summer’s Primavera Sound ’26 festivals in Buenos Aires, Argentina and São Paulo, Brazil will feature headlining sets from Gorillaz, The Strokes, FKA Twigs and Lily Allen, who will perform her West End Girl album in its entirety.

The offshoots from the original Primavera Sound Barcelona — which takes place from June 3-7 in Madrid this year — will be held, respectively, in Buenos Aires on Nov. 28-29 and São Paulo on Dec. 5-6.

Other acts slated to play both events include: Yung Lean, CMAT, Courtney Barnett, underscores, Danny L Harle, Nation of Language, Juana Molina, Santi Motorizado, Cara Delevingne, Smerz, Marilina Bertoldi, Mannequin Pussy, Model/Actriz, Juliana Gattas and more. The two cities previously hosted Primavera events in 2022 and 2023.

At press time the Buenos Aires event had not revealed its location, while the São Paulo show will once again take place at Interlagos Circuit, which hosted it in 2023. The official presale for Primavera Sound Buenos Aires will open today (May 12) for BBVA customers, with a general on sale slated to open once the presale has sold out. Tickets for the São Paulo edition will go on sale soon on the Ingresse ticketing platform; click here for tickets.

The lineup for this summer’s Primavera Sound Barcelona will feature The Cure, Doja Cat, Gorillaz, The xx, Bad Gyal, Massive Attack, Mac DeMarco, Blood Orange, Addison Rae, Skrillex, PinkPantheress, Role Model, My Bloody Valentine, Dijon, Little Simz, Carl Cox, Geese, Father John Misty and many more.
